justifications.D1: "a candidate must exceed the 99th percentile of this null, not merely the fixed 0.92/3.0/1.0 thresholds, to be called Tier-3-confirmed" — construction-induced similarity is converted into a permutation-calibrated hard gate, with silence framed as the expected deliverable.
justifications.D3: "if the L-function-zeros catalog contributes zero Tier-1 cross-domain buckets ... the sub-hypothesis ... is falsified" — numeric falsifiers F1-F4 with a cheap early Tier-1 kill and a no-retuning stopping rule.
justifications.D4: "condition on prime-theoretic covariates (size, gap, residue class mod 6/12/30) before recomputing Tier-2 similarity" — the summary's confounds are each addressed by the 7-layer/permutation stack, but there is no positive anchor demonstrating the pipeline detects a real known correspondence.
justifications.D5: "a permutation-calibrated threshold is the only way this design adds information beyond the existing run" — a superseding rerun that explicitly states its new cell (fifth catalog plus preregistered gauntlet, F3 mechanism discrimination).
justifications.D6: "a null result here is itself the deliverable (per F1), not a reason to keep adjusting the pipeline" — every branch pre-committed, including the PENDING-really-untested labeling and the lost-pairs vacuous reading.

justifications.D1: "DISQUALIFY regardless of p-value if the null mean itself sits within 2 percentage points of chance" — the vacuous-null and feature-geometry failures are converted into explicit disqualification gates (density-marginal step 4, null-gap check).
justifications.D3: "if the density-marginal control alone (step 4) already reduces the entire top-K list to below-null in every domain pair at the halfway point ... the whole cycle reported as REFUTED" — numeric gates 1-4 plus a program-level kill and a cheap early futility stop.
justifications.D4: "re-run the exact predecessor negative results ... as a positive-control-for-nullness check" — every summary confound has a concrete defense, but the calibration check is for nullness only; no gate demonstrates the pipeline detects a real positive signal.
justifications.D5: "This revival treats that as the base rate to beat, not a warm-up finding" — explicitly states the new cells: density-matched null, native-vocabulary complement, and the vacuity gap check absent from prior runs.
justifications.D6: "Falsified as VACUOUS if any candidate meets (2)'s p-value but fails the null-gap check" — every branch (ARTIFACT, VACUOUS, CONFIRMED_KNOWN, CANDIDATE_SUPPORTED, REFUTED-for-this-vocabulary) is pre-committed.

justifications.D1: "repurposed as the Stage 0 negative calibration anchor (must reproduce exactly 0 hits at 10^-40) rather than a hypothesis to re-test" — prior kills become calibration gates and the feature-geometry failure becomes the mandatory marginal-shuffle control (F3).
justifications.D3: "Stage 0 (calibration) is attempted at most twice per pipeline configuration; two failures -> terminal ABANDON" — numeric F1-F7 with cheap early mechanism-independent anchor falsifiers (F5) and hard cell-level stops.
justifications.D4: "Recover two known anchors through the exact same similarity-ranking pipeline" — every summary confound addressed (marginal shuffle, stratified null, prime detrending, SVD ban) plus explicit positive and negative anchor controls.
justifications.D5: "feature-vector similarity is a Layer-1/2 instrument with no known mechanism for Layer-3 transformations" — reframes the settled question and states the generic-vs-native cell this design fills.
justifications.D6: "Pairs with no such candidate are marked UNTESTABLE and excluded from Stage 1, not silently scored" — every branch, including VACUOUS, VOID, FEATURE_GEOMETRY, and UNTESTABLE, is pre-committed.

justifications.D1: "the McMullen K3 construction ... serves as a negative anchor to certify that the pipeline can produce zero when the ground truth is zero" — the prior kills are converted into terminal Stage-0 gates plus a mandatory feature-geometry marginal-shuffle kill (F3).
justifications.D3: "Stage 0 failures are terminal ... ABANDON, no Stage 1, no redesign loop" — numeric F1-F7 with cheap early mechanism-independent anchor falsifiers and explicit per-cell stops.
justifications.D4: "Positive anchor: EC quadratic twist (900 test curves, 12 isogeny classes) → expect ≥4,000 relations, ≥95% LMFDB-recorded after class dedup" — every summary confound addressed plus explicit positive and negative controls demonstrating instrument sensitivity.
justifications.D5: "will fail to rank candidate cross-domain bridges above a correctly-specified null — reproducing the prior finding that seven generic operators found zero relations" — an explicitly framed anchored rerun/extension, but the scope-reduced design states no distinct new empirical cell beyond replication with a corrected null.
justifications.D6: "threshold violation → cell VACUOUS, no D reportable" — VACUOUS, FEATURE_GEOMETRY, VOID, and generic-null-is-vocabulary-not-absence readings pre-commit every branch, with the expected 0-hit outcome accepted as a valid falsifying result.
